items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: And the bass player was Chuck Bader. He, you know, Chuck Bader went with Lionel Hampton. He was the first player to play electronic bass in Lionel Hampton band. And we'd hear that. I heard that bass.

ctx.x: Yeah. Downstairs and we were upstairs. Yeah, upstairs. And Lionel Hampton said, he said, I know y'all are there. He said, I can't see you, but I can hear you. See, we were upstairs. He said, maybe one day we'll all be together. You know, but that's just a comment. And there was nothing big made out of it. Yeah. But he just, he passed that comment. And, uh, the first electronic bass in a band, I heard, was in Lionel Hampton band. And the bass player was Chuck Bader. He, you know, Chuck Bader went with Lionel…
I would sing, you know. But, um, and musically, I would think of that. First of all, first of all, first of all, first I started to go to, uh, I would sing, you know.
